articles.title: AI giant Anthropic files for blockbuster IPO
articles.snippet: The maker of Claude reported $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and an $80.7 billion net loss as it aims to price its offering in mid-November.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin dips below $80,000 as stocks rally following Anthropic IPO filing
articles.snippet: Alongside Anthropic raising as much as $100 billion, Meta on Monday announced a $95 billion share sale to fund its own AI ambitions.

articles.title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
articles.snippet: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

articles.title: Anthropic Makes IPO Filing Public, Plans Nasdaq Listing Under ‘ANT’
articles.snippet: The S-1 shows revenue up from $1.2 billion a year earlier, and a share structure that leaves a trust and the co-founders in control.

articles.title: SpaceX Filing Gives Elon Musk the Final Word on Tesla Merger He Says He’s Staying Out Of
articles.snippet: SpaceX’s latest 10-Q filing quietly confirms any Tesla combination requires sign-off from its “controlling shareholder.”
